# Reliable and Responsive System Builder Canvas Implementation Roadmap

- Status: `completed`
- Updated: `2026-10-22T01:41:02Z`

## Objective

Build useful multi-component systems from an empty workspace without lost edits or stalled Canvas loads, and measure and improve actual editor responsiveness on both hosts.

## Discovery

Current Composer is the accepted click-to-add/move editor; drag/drop was explicitly removed by an earlier completed roadmap. Existing16focused UI tests and a real isolated Chrome browse/save/reopen journey pass, but do not cover useful multi-system construction, edit races or responsiveness. Independent current-source review reproduced the bounded-history dirty-state defect and identified creation/save/layout data-loss paths, optional-history load blocking and eager catalog/full-draft work.

### Security impact

- Disposition: `security-relevant`
- Summary: UI state and asynchronous host responses must preserve authorized workspace identity, immutable revisions, user edits and bounded untrusted previews.
- Protected assets:
  - Unsaved drafts and saved immutable revisions
  - Workspace and organization ownership
  - Safe UI diagnostics and synthetic test evidence
- Trust boundaries:
  - UI to typed application clients and authorized host operations
  - Asset configurations and placements to bounded declarative previews
  - Test harness to disposable local host/credential lifecycle
- Abuse and failure cases:
  - Late response replaces another workspace/system draft
  - Dirty history rollover allows unintended discard
  - Performance optimization skips authorization/version validation
  - Tests report static samples or denied functionality as successful runtime behavior
- Controls:
  - Saved checkpoints and operation generations
  - Explicit unsaved-work guard and sanitized recoverable failures
  - Bounded demand-driven reads and immutable structural sharing
  - Real UI assertions with isolated synthetic data and source identity
- Verification:
  - Deferred-response and history-overflow UI regressions
  - Mixed-component systems built via actual UI, save/reopen and behavior checks
  - Measured cold load/input/add/move/undo with no assertion weakening
  - Focused denial and cross-workspace tests plus independent review
- Residual risks:
  - Representative hardware, manual assistive technology and participants unavailable
  - Controlled runtime fixture behavior is not real-model quality qualification

### Constraints

- Preserve existing canonical placements, exact asset versions, workspace authorization and shared React editor; no replacement framework or drag architecture is selected.
- User explicitly requests a meaningful test suite now. Diagnostic reproduction tests are authorized; roadmap implementation approval remains distinct.
- Build multiple systems by UI actions from an empty workspace, not only predefined templates or populated fixtures. Exercise useful behavior, mixed component types, persistence and downstream build checks.
- Keep controlled model/participant/accessibility/reference-environment qualification pending; retain original supplier and failed dependency gate.

## Increment 1: Reliable multi-system editing and recovery

- Id: `reliable-editing-and-recovery`
- Status: `completed`
- Dependencies: None

Reproduce and fix state-loss and stuck-load defects, with useful multi-component UI journeys.

### Work packages

- **Meaningful journey and race regression coverage** (`journeys-and-races`): Three scratch-built systems plus deferred-response, rejection and history-overflow tests prove preservation of actual work.
- **Draft and request ownership** (`state-recovery`): Saved checkpoints, creation/switch guards, transaction fencing and recoverable loads protect edits.

### Deliverables

- Source-identified mixed-component UI test matrix
- No-data-loss dirty/save/layout/switch regression coverage
- Independent current-revision and optional history loading with retry
- Shared desktop/thin-client behavior and updated owning documentation

### Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Qualification | Latest evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meaningful-scratch-systems`: Build at least three distinct useful systems through the UI, each combining at least four component kinds: data entry/review, operations dashboard and conversation interface. Assert declared supported behavior, exact references, placements, configuration, save/reopen and checked builds where supported; static fixture rendering alone never proves application behavior. | local | passed (test) |
| `draft-integrity-and-recovery`: History beyond50edits, create/switch while dirty, delayed save/layout, rejected requests and cross-workspace late responses preserve edits and offer an actionable recovery path without stuck loading or duplicate mutations. | local | passed (test) |
| `security-impact-reviewed`: Review workspace/system request identity, safe diagnostic and preview bounds, failure behavior and rollback; retain existing authority and controlled pending gaps. | local | passed (review) |

### Verification

- Run focused Workspace/editor/history regressions and negative cases per chunk.
- Run real isolated Chrome and packaged desktop meaningful-system journeys when available; retain every failed attempt.
- Run applicable documentation/architecture checks and independent criterion review.

### Rollback

Retain unsaved-work guards, generation fencing and authority denial; disable an unavailable action rather than restoring silent discard.

### Excluded

- New drag framework or replacing the approved click-based editor
- Real provider/model quality and production mutation
